scope: Sequential application-only installation of controller-first Console OS 0.4.70 on both recorded Waveshare 4.3 consoles, verifying that Console OS automatically registers multiplayer-capable validated P4G manifests and exposes P4 Yahtzee without game-authored registration code.

source.commit_subject: feat: let Console OS register multiplayer games

installation.method: sequential guarded H1 writes; no parallel flash
installation.write_scope: application partition only at 0x20000; bootloader, partition table, OTA data, NVS, and microSD were not written
installation.successor_contract: first 1760240 bytes exactly match the application image and the remaining 1040 bytes are erased 0xff
installation.factory_backup_reason: both exact recorded units already had full 32 MiB factory backups whose hashes were recomputed and matched hardware/backups/manifest.json before this install

boards.security: secure boot disabled; flash encryption disabled
boards.write: pass; esptool Hash of data verified
boards.readback: pass; exact application bytes plus 1040-byte erased padding

verification.game_contract: declarative validated P4G manifest; no first-run registration prompt or game-owned registry mutation
verification.multiplayer_transports: direct UART ready with H1 relay fallback ready on both units
verification.transient_startup_display_note: Each unit logged an acknowledged MIPI submit timeout during startup and recovered to READY with display_failures=0; no panic or reboot loop followed.
